# jev-planner

> A CLI that writes a coding plan with two agents and a judge: Codex and Claude
> Code draft and cross-review, and Jev picks the finalizer. One package,
> `jev-planner`, published to npm. Node >= 20.19. MIT. Ships ESM and CommonJS.

This file is an index. It points to the files that document the package and
restates none of their content, so there is nothing here to drift from the
source.

## Packages

The package ships its `llms.txt` inside its tarball, so after an install it can
be read from `node_modules/jev-planner/llms.txt` with no network access.

- [jev-planner](packages/jev-planner/llms.txt): the install line, the API, a
  working example, and the mistakes to avoid.

## Docs

The documentation site is published as part of rxova.org. Every page there also
exists as raw markdown — add `.md` to any URL.

- [Documentation](https://rxova.org/packages/jev-planner/): guides and
  reference.
- [README](packages/jev-planner/README.md): usage and options. Also in the
  tarball.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jev-planner): the published versions.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and commands for an agent editing this
  repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, the quality gates, commits,
  changesets and releases.
